verdict: Paid ads paused 21 days; Meta leads this period came before the stop.
narrative: All paid advertising stopped after September 16 and has not run since — the 26 leads and $504 in spend this period belong entirely to the first week of the window. Before the pause, Meta was delivering leads at $19.38 each; Google Ads spent $106 over the same stretch with zero conversions, making it the weakest part of the mix. Eight setup milestones — including conversion tracking, landing pages, and audience infrastructure — are overdue and are what's blocking campaigns from restarting at full strength. Work to clear those items is active now, and ads are scheduled to resume once the foundation is confirmed. Once campaigns are back on, you should see lead volume and attribution both improve in the next reporting period.
